sources: Florida PSC, 'Total Cost for 1,000 kWh - Residential Service', March 2026 (period January-December 2026): https://www.floridapsc.com/pscfiles/website-files/PDF/Utilities/Electricgas/BillingAdjustments/ba_total-2026_oldmar26.pdf
notes: Tier break at 1,000 kWh applies to base energy and fuel; the other clauses are flat per kWh.
Residential customers whose monthly base electric service costs fall below $30 are subject to a minimum $30 base bill (source note).
No seasonal differentiation in RS-1 as published on this sheet.
Taxes, franchise fees and other local charges are not on the sheet and are excluded.
version_note: Same RS-1 rates as FPL's January 2026 insert; unchanged through August per the PSC's March and August tables.
